card.name: Ending 'on' inside split words
card.fires_on: The pieces 'on' or 'ons' that finish a word cut into parts, such as octog-on, wag-ons, non-g-on-ococcal, non-g-on-adal and antag-on-ists. It appears when the earlier part of the word is incomplete.

modes.label: Wagon and octagon
modes.description: 'on' or 'ons' ends a common noun split after a short stem like wag or octog.
modes.example: Railway wag<<ons>> are used as transport for exports.

modes.label: Gonad and gonococcal terms
modes.description: 'on' sits right after 'g' in non-gonococcal or non-gonadal.
modes.example: Genital ulcer disease (chancroid) Non-g<<on>>ococcal urethritis and cervicit

modes.label: Antagonist
modes.description: 'on' in the middle of antagonists after 'antag'.
